profile.headline: Wireless Professional
profile.summary:
Developed Generative Machine Learning for DNA Sequence Based Music

• Recurrent Neural Network Modeling (https://sites.google.com/site/ribosonics/)

Wireless Telecommunication:

• CDMA Data Modem for KDDI, Japan – Making, debugging, finalizing the customization of CDMA modem firmware. Pass lab and field tests. Implementing OTA Provisioning.
• SnapTrack GPS Location Technique (as known as GPSOne) – Making, debugging, finalizing the customization of CDMA phone firmware for field tests taken in Seattle and Tampa, Florida.
• Development of Data Service System for CDMA IMT2000 System
• Knowledge of debugging tools

Internet of Things:

• Home Security and Automation, Medical Devices
• Firmware Development for IOT Devices
• Arduino AWS IOT Implementation: ESP32 WiFi/BLE Module based solution

Android and Embedded Linux System:

• Making Kernel daemons to interface various medical devices and communicate with user interface apps and remote servers over TCP/IP links.
• Android App Programming for status monitoring and user interface to Kernel daemons.
• USB and Serial Port Programming
• Bluetooth and WiFi Programming

Electronic Medical Records System:

• OpenVistA EMR system
• Programming with MUMPS language
• Programming HL7 Message Processing

Signal and Image Processing:

• Paging System for Mechanical Telephone in Russia – Design the algorithm, simulate the signal processing engine in C programs with data collected from the site, make real time engine in TMS320 series assembly codes, and deploy the solution for commercial service (US Patent awarded).
• Neural Network Modeling for image compression.
• Fractal Image Compression.

Programming Languages and Tools:

• C/C++, MUMPS, IntelliJ, Java, Delphi 7, Delphi 2007, Eclipse, Arduino, Visual Studio Micro
• JTAG ARM debugging tools

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: He is involved in the implementation and development of IT-based EMR system and the interfaces from various medical devices for patients.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: Anyuser is a VoIP service provider established in United States of America, November 2004. As CTO, my main job objective was to establish commercially operable VoIP server system.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: He implemented Over-the-Air functionality of CDMA data module for M2M Japan. M2M Japan is the KDDI-approved local distributor and they are responsible to provide maintenance and after services. The OTA specifications was released by KDDI and I implemented the OTA function for M2M Japan. The OTA functionality is based on HTTPS/TCP/IP protocol stacks, which uses highly secured encryption algorithm. The OTA was developed and tested. Since then, he was consulting them for the operation of data module and necessary modifications.

positions.title: Senior Manager
positions.description: He joined PTR because he was interested in the development of CDMA data module that is for KDDI. KDDI was the only CDMA service provider in Japan at that time. As a project leader and software engineer, he was taking the lead on the overall implementation and successful roll-out of a CDMA2000 / J-CDMA module.
